gateway.scp_unleashed.destination.scp466: Beyond this gateway it is always winter. What waits there is meant to frighten: a figure in the trees, isolation, dread and implied violence.
Nothing you carry comes with you. Your belongings will be kept for you here.
There is no way back the way you came.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp4666_spawn_egg: SCP-4666 is a very tall, gaunt old man who keeps to the edge of the trees in a place where it is always winter.
It cannot be hurt. It does not like to be watched.
Recover the SCP-4666 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A courier will find you with a shard.

book.scp_unleashed.scp4666_diary.0.0: Night one. The gate shut behind me and the snow filled in my tracks. The cabin was warm, as if somebody had only just stepped out. The beds were made.
book.scp_unleashed.scp4666_diary.0.1: Night two. There was a box on the porch this morning. Cocoa, still hot, and bread. I do not know who left it. I drank it on the step and felt better than I have in weeks.
book.scp_unleashed.scp4666_diary.0.2: Night four. There is a man in the trees. Very tall. He walks round and round the cabin, far out, the way a dog circles before it lies down. When I looked straight at him he was gone.
book.scp_unleashed.scp4666_diary.0.3: I have stopped looking out of the windows at night. It is easier.
book.scp_unleashed.scp4666_diary.1.0: Something walked across the roof last night, slowly, from one end to the other. It stopped above my bed.
book.scp_unleashed.scp4666_diary.1.1: The gramophone was playing when I came down. I had not wound it. The carol was wrong, slower and lower, like someone humming it from memory.
book.scp_unleashed.scp4666_diary.1.2: Footprints this morning. Bare feet. They came out of the trees and stopped under my window.
book.scp_unleashed.scp4666_diary.1.3: I keep the tree lit now. I could not tell you why that matters, but the house feels less watched when it glows.
book.scp_unleashed.scp4666_diary.2.0: The food has stopped coming. The cocoa still comes. I drink every drop.
book.scp_unleashed.scp4666_diary.2.1: There is a stocking on the mantel with my name on it. I did not hang it.
book.scp_unleashed.scp4666_diary.2.2: The lamps died today, all at once. The switch clicks and nothing happens. The fire and the tree still burn.
book.scp_unleashed.scp4666_diary.2.3: Knocking at the front door. Three knocks, then nothing. Then three more at the side.
book.scp_unleashed.scp4666_diary.2.4: When I am upstairs I can hear breathing in the cellar. When I go down, it stops.
book.scp_unleashed.scp4666_diary.3.0: This is not my first winter here. The last one ended in the cellar. I will not write about that.
book.scp_unleashed.scp4666_diary.3.1: He wants a quiet house, I think. Warm. Grateful. Not curious.
book.scp_unleashed.scp4666_diary.3.2: There is a way out on the last morning, for some. I was not one of them the first time.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.title: The Yule Man
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.caption: SCP-4666 photographed at the treeline of Location-4666-W. The image was recovered from a camera left on the cabin porch.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.0.text.0: SCP-4666 is confined to Location-4666-W, a pocket of perpetual winter reached only through a powered Contained Gateway fitted with an attuned shard. The gateway is to be powered only for authorised entries.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.0.text.1: Personnel cannot carry equipment into Location-4666-W. Belongings are held at the gateway and returned on exit. Entry personnel are advised to keep to the cabin after dark.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.0.text.2: **Personnel are not to watch the treeline.** Web crawlers continue to watch for winter disappearances matching SCP-4666's pattern elsewhere.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.1.text.0: SCP-4666 is an extremely tall, emaciated humanoid resembling an elderly man, between 2 and 2.3 metres in height. Its skin is pale and sallow, its ribs and collarbones are plainly visible and its arms are disproportionately long, ending in long, thin fingers.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.1.text.1: It has thin grey hair, balding at the crown, and a sparse grey beard. Its eyes are deep set and dark. It wears only a pair of old, dark trousers and goes barefoot in any cold.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.1.text.2: Fingerprints recovered from SCP-4666 show a double whorl pattern unknown in humans. White hairs have been recovered at several sites. No usable genetic material has been extracted from any of them.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.1.text.3: SCP-4666 is active over a fixed run of nights in midwinter, an occurrence referred to as a Weissnacht Event. During an event it attaches itself to a single household. Early on it is seen only at a distance, at the edge of the trees. Later it is heard on roofs and at doors, and later still it is seen at windows.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.1.text.4: SCP-4666 does not respond to communication and has never been harmed by any means attempted. It appears able to cross great distances almost instantly.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.2.title: Addendum 4666-1: Weissnacht Event Log
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.2.text.0: 1874, Telemark: a farmstead was found empty after the final night of an event. Snow had drifted in through the open door. The household was not recovered.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.2.text.1: 1931, Saskatchewan: a family reported a very tall man circling their property for nine nights. On the last morning they found wrapped gifts beneath their tree that none of them had bought. The family was unharmed. The gifts were confiscated.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.2.text.2: 1996, Akureyri: occupants reported footsteps on the roof and a face at an upstairs window. The house was found empty the morning after the final night. %rRemainder of entry withheld.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.3.title: Addendum 4666-2: Location-4666-W
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.3.text.0: In %r1998%r SCP-4666 was followed into a winter of its own making and the way out was closed behind it. Location-4666-W is what remains: a forest that does not end, a single cabin, and fourteen nights that begin again whenever the cabin stands empty.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.3.text.1: Entrants report that walking away from the cabin only brings them back to it. Nobody has found the edge of the woods.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.4.title: Addendum 4666-3: Recovery
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.4.text: Shards attuned to Location-4666-W are delivered to readers of this file. See field notes.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.5.title: Addendum 4666-4: Note Left on the Cabin Table
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.5.text.0: Whoever leaves the box at the door wants you warm, I think. I am less sure about the one at the window.
dossier.scp_unleashed.4666.page.5.text.1: If you hear him on the roof, stay in bed. %rDr. Vale%r

message.scp_unleashed.scp4666.calendar_h: Behind the little door, a paper log. The hearth will want feeding before dark.
A painted lump of coal. Something under the floor has gone cold.
A tiny axe. There is a stump by the side door.
A drawing of a quiet house. He hears more than you think.
A paper window with a crack drawn across it.
A scrap of brown paper and a twist of twine. He likes to be remembered.
A painted loaf. The box will not always come.
A tiny boiler with its door open. Cold cellars make for long nights.
A lit window. Do not stand at it for long.
Nothing behind this door but a crumb.
A tiny stocking. It is empty.
A paper lamp, already burnt out.
A drawing of the front door, and someone standing outside it.
The last door. A tiny cabin, warm and lit.

guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.heading: Chores
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.intro: Whoever stays here keeps the house. This is what needs doing.
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.firewood.tex: The stump by the side door still has its axe in it. Hold your hand to it and keep at it until the round splits. You can only carry so much at once.
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.hearth.title: The hearth
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.hearth.text: Feed the grate one split log at a time. When it sinks to embers the house goes cold, and the cold gets into you quickly.
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.coal.title: The boiler
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.coal.text: The boiler in the cellar takes coal. The bin is in the woodshed out back. Fill the scuttle there, carry it in through the side door and down the cellar stairs, and tip it into the firebox. It is heavy.
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.windows.text: Glass cracks out here. Saw boards at the workbench in the cellar, then hold them over the broken pane until they are nailed fast.
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.gift.title: A gift
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.gift.text: There are old things in the trunks. Wrap one in brown paper and set it under the tree. One a day is plenty.
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.bread.title: Bread
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.bread.text: When the box stops bringing food, take oats from a pantry shelf and bake them in the stove oven. Take the loaves out when they are done.
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.kettle.title: Kettle and gramophone
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.kettle.text: The kettle on the stove boils water for something warm to drink. The gramophone in the living room still plays.
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.calendar.tex: Open one little door each day. There is always something behind it.
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.gear.title: Coats and hats
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.gear.text: Each coat hook holds a hat, a coat and a pair of boots. Wear them outside. The wool wears through in the snow, so hang them back up when you come in. There are no more.
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.bed.title: Bed
guide.scp_unleashed.scp4666.bed.text: When the night is at its deepest, go to bed. Everyone has to sleep before morning comes, and nobody sleeps while they are shaking with cold.
